title: 焚化餘熱鍋爐整合
summary: 本課以「連結焚化熱輸入、傳熱阻力與蒸汽循環的能量平衡」為主軸，依序處理焚化熱輸入基準、給水與蒸汽焓差、煙側差壓與堵塞診斷、循環泵與給水輔機、量測誤差與能量閉合。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect incinerator heat input, thermal resistance and the steam cycle, progressing through Incineration heat-input basis, Feedwater-to-steam enthalpy rise, Gas-side pressure drop and blockage, Circulation and feedwater auxiliaries, Measurement error and energy closure. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 焚化熱輸入基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Incineration heat-input basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 焚化熱輸入基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Incineration heat-input basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先固定濕基低位熱值與進料時間窗，再討論鍋爐的熱回收比例。 燃料熱輸入由濕基進料量與對應低位熱值決定；相同噸數可能帶入不同熱量。
steps.instructionEn: Fix wet-basis lower heating value and feed interval before discussing boiler heat recovery. Fuel heat input is wet feed multiplied by its corresponding lower heating value; equal tonnage can carry different heat input.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.
steps.failure: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「焚化熱輸入基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mass-flow control alone misses heat-load changes caused by moisture and heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Incineration heat-input basis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「焚化熱輸入基準」，依代表性分樣求含水與熱值，和料重、蒸汽負荷及未燃分交叉檢查。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Incineration heat-input basis, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 LHV 改成 6 MJ/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4.44444 變成 3.33333 MW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only LHV to 6 MJ/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4.44444 to 3.33333 MW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 煙氣顯熱曲線：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Flue-gas sensible-heat curve: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 煙氣顯熱曲線 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Flue-gas sensible-heat curve and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用各受熱面前後溫度建立能量梯度，辨認熱量移除的主要區段。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。
steps.instructionEn: Use temperatures across heating surfaces to map energy gradients and identify major heat-removal sections. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW.
